At home tonight — the Square: Odette, Lian; the Market: Hollis, Agnes, Bartholomew; the Docks: Dorian, Nisha; Chapel Hill: Merrin, Isolde, Edda.
The Demon does not kill on the night before you arrive. It kills from night 1.

reply:
You let the evening pass.

=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Agnes saying they saw Edda on the Market (the night before you arrived); or Edda's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived)."  [case board: #52, #53, #26, #28]
Edda: "Call it kitchen sense if you want, friends—something's sour with Dorian."  [case board: #54]
Dorian: "I know everyone's going to read into this, sorry, but here it is: I am the Clerk."
Dorian: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Odette and Nisha is the Martyr."  [case board: #55, #56]
Nisha: "It isn't a locked deduction yet, still—my read on Edda isn't clean."  [case board: #57]
Odette: "Are we doing public confessions tonight? Let's get mine over with: I am the Archivist."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Dorian and Bartholomew is the Poisoner."  [case board: #58, #59]
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it. I am the Lamplighter."
Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 7 others out."
Bartholomew: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 2 others out."
Bartholomew: "I'm with Nisha. Something off with Edda. I saw them out on the Market the night before you arrived."  [case board: #60, #61, #62, #63, #64]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Gravedigger."  [case board: #65]
Merrin: "Hear Nisha well, for I too see the shadow upon Edda!"  [case board: #66]
